question: How does the unfolding configuration return to absorption after forming a sixfold structure?
premises: Two triangles join to form a six-spoked configuration.
This occurs in the dynamic of unfolding.
The same configuration can return to absorption in its source.
inference: The sixfold manifestation is a phase of unfolding that can dissolve back into identity with its source.
uncertainties: The symbolic referent of the triangles is not explicit in this verse alone.
plain_english: When two triangles join, the configuration moves into a six-spoked state; yet even in that unfolding, it goes again into absorption in that same reality.
